2609.19885.title: Evaluating Communicative Success in Machine-Translated Conversation
2609.19885.paper_summary: Interpreter agents built on machine translation (MT) increasingly mediate live conversation between people who do not share a language, yet we still evaluate them with metrics built for isolated sentences, which measure fidelity rather than whether communication succeeds. We introduce a reusable three-layer checklist-and-judge framework that evaluates interpreter-mediated conversation across semantic, pragmatic, and cultural-social dimensions, covering the naturalness, intent, and social appropriateness that fidelity metrics leave unmeasured. It runs in both single-turn and interactive multi-turn settings, where simulated users reply to translated messages as the conversation unfolds and each turn is scored alongside the conversation as a whole. We extensively validate it through controlled perturbations, cross-judge comparisons, and human annotations. Our main single-turn benchmark evaluates 10 interpreter setups across Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian, and Korean from 5,624 OpenSubtitles-derived scenarios spanning 12 translation directions, and our multi-turn study covers all 6 language pairs in scripted and live modes. Results show a consistent decline from semantic to pragmatic and cultural-social success, while conventional MT metrics overlook failures among stronger interpreters, and prompt ablations show that scenario context, structured instructions, and cultural context improve communicative success, although gains vary across setups. Our work thus provides an evaluation framework and benchmark for interpreter agents in conversation, and highlights the importance of communicative success alongside existing translation metrics.
2609.19885.paper_summary_zh: 翻譯基於機器翻譯 (MT) 的口譯代理越來越多地在不共享語言的人之間進行即時對話，但我們仍然使用為孤立句子構建的指標來評估它們，這些指標測量的是忠實度，而不是交流是否成功。<lb/>我們引入了一個可重用的三層檢查清單和評判框架，該框架在語義、語用和文化社會維度上評估口譯介導的對話，涵蓋了忠實度指標未測量的自然性、意圖和社會適宜性。<lb/>它在單輪和互動多輪設置中運行，模擬用戶在對話進行時對翻譯消息進行回覆，每輪的評分與整個對話一起進行。<lb/>我們通過受控擾動、交叉評判比較和人工註釋對其進行了廣泛的驗證。<lb/>我們的主要單輪基準評估了來自 5,624 個基於 OpenSubtitles 的場景的 10 種口譯設置，涵蓋阿拉伯語、孟加拉語、印尼語和韓語，這些場景跨越 12 種翻譯方向，而我們的多輪研究涵蓋了所有 6 對語言的腳本和即時模式。<lb/>結果顯示，從語義到語用再到文化社會成功的過程中，成功率穩定下降，而傳統的 MT 指標忽略了更強口譯者之間的失敗，並且提示消融顯示場景上下文、結構化指示和文化背景改善了交流成功，儘管增益在不同設置中有所不同。<lb/>因此，我們的工作提供了一個口譯代理在對話中評估的框架和基準，並強調了交流成功的重要性，這一點與現有的翻譯指標並行。
